title: OpenSourceCheck Attestation
description: One signed record of a single LLM-assisted security-review run over an open-source project at an exact commit. Records what was checked, by which model, with which prompts, and what a human validator concluded. Never asserts that code is 'safe'.

schema.description: Schema version identifier. Frozen per major version.

repo.description: Canonical source URL of the audited project.

commit.description: Full 40-char git commit SHA-1 that was audited. Never a branch name — a branch moves and makes the record meaningless.

subpath.description: Optional path within the repo that scopes the audit, e.g. 'shared/'.

date.description: UTC date the run was performed (YYYY-MM-DD).

model.description: Exact model identifier used, e.g. 'claude-opus-4-8', 'gpt-5', 'gemini-3-pro', 'local:qwen3-coder-480b'. Never a marketing name.

harness.description: Tool/agent that drove the model, incl. version, e.g. 'claude-code v3.1', 'manual-chat', 'custom-script'.

prompts_ref.description: Repo-relative path to the exact prompt pack used, under prompts/. Enables re-running the audit.

transcript_sha256.description: SHA-256 of the full run transcript. The transcript itself lives under transcripts/ or in an external artifact store referenced by transcript_uri.

transcript_uri.description: Optional location of the full transcript when too large to store in-repo (repo-relative path, https URL, ipfs://, or magnet:).

scope.description: What was and was NOT covered by this run. Required — an audit with unstated scope is not interpretable.

duration_minutes.description: Optional wall-clock minutes for the run.

cost_estimate_usd.description: Optional estimated model cost in USD.

runs_count.description: Optional number of independent repetitions this attestation aggregates. LLM runs are non-deterministic; >1 strengthens signal.

findings.description: Zero or more findings. An empty array is invalid; a run that surfaced nothing MUST contain exactly one finding with severity 'none-found'.

severity.description: Severity of the finding. 'none-found' is a first-class result meaning the run reported nothing in scope.

status.description: Human-triage status. Raw model output is 'unreviewed'; only a named validator may set 'validated'. Medium+ findings in live software use 'withheld-pending-disclosure' with the body redacted until disclosure.

summary.description: Short human-readable statement of the finding. Redacted to a placeholder when status is 'withheld-pending-disclosure'.

location.description: Optional file:line or symbol where the finding sits.

body_sha256.description: For withheld findings: SHA-256 of the full finding text. Commits the auditor to content + timestamp without revealing it (provable priority, no leak).

validator.description: Identifier of the human who set 'status'. Required for 'validated' or 'false-positive'.

validator_notes.description: How the finding was reproduced or refuted.

reported_to.description: Security contact the finding was reported to.

embargo_until.description: Earliest date the body may be published.

verdict.description: Run-level conclusion. 'clean-run' = ran to completion in scope, nothing found. This is NOT 'the code is safe' — a clean AI run can and does miss real bugs (see Coldcard, 2026).

id.description: Stable auditor slug matching a file under auditors/<id>.json.

signature.description: Detached signature over the payload 'osc-attestation/v0\n' + RFC-8785-canonical JSON of this object with 'signature' removed. Any of three schemes; the signing key must be registered under auditors/<id>.json.

alg.description: Signature scheme: nostr-schnorr (BIP-340/secp256k1, principal=npub), ssh-ed25519 (OpenSSH sig, principal=identity), or pgp (OpenPGP detached sig, principal=key fingerprint).

principal.description: Signer identity: an npub (nostr), an SSH principal string (ssh), or a hex key fingerprint/long-id (pgp).

value.description: The signature: 128-hex (nostr schnorr), an armored SSHSIG block (ssh), or an armored PGP signature block (pgp).
